headline: Ethereal Machines Series B by Avataar Ventures & Peak XV
sum: Ethereal Machines raised $28.5 million in Series B led by Avataar Venture Partners, with participation from Peak XV Partners (increasing stake to 16.36%) and Novellus Systems. Capital will fund a 300,000-sq-ft manufacturing facility near Bengaluru, India's first indigenous multi-axis CNC controller, and international expansion across US and Europe.
implication: The deployment of integrated tax, legal and due diligence support by a single advisory boutique (Aritra) signals investor preference for founder-centric counsel in capital-intensive deep-tech, whilst parallel representation of major LPs (JSA for Peak XV) demonstrates regulatory appetite for investor-side documentation on sub-$30m growth-stage rounds.
detail: <cite index="1-1">Ethereal Machines raised $28.5 million in Series B led by Avataar Ventures, with participation from Peak XV Partners and other investors.</cite> <cite index="1-2">Since its $13 million Series A in June 2024, the company has grown its Machining-as-a-Service (MaaS) revenue threefold year-on-year and scaled production capacity tenfold.</cite> <cite index="34-2">The board approved issuance of 29,214 Series B preference shares at ₹90,536 each per RoC filing.</cite> <cite index="34-9,34-10,34-11">Post-allotment, Avataar holds 13.69%, Peak XV 16.36%, and co-founders retain 24.17%.</cite>
